description.en: The ID of the SCIM credential.

descriptions.zh:
删除SCIM密钥后，使用该SCIM密钥的同步任务将会失败。

本文将提供一个示例，删除ID为`scimcred-004whl0kvfwcypbi****`的SCIM密钥。
descriptions.en:
After a SCIM credential is deleted, the synchronization task that uses the SCIM credential fails.

This topic provides an example on how to delete the SCIM credential whose ID is `scimcred-004whl0kvfwcypbi****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso delete-scim-server-credential --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --credential-id scimcred-004whl0kvfwcypbi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
